**中文**"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"> **One-line positioning**: lets DeepSeek Harness (DSH, the execution layer) reach the OpenClaw (bra"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"in/persona layer)

(HTTP Upgrade + origin allowlist + Ed25519 signature pairing + `connect.challenge` → `hello-ok`),
t"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"hen calls methods in a JSON-RPC style.

executes it → atomically writes back `Output/<taskId>_result"},{"id":"p10s5","text":".json`, optionally notifying a Discord
channel via `oc-send`.
3. **Windows desktop execution (v1.1+)"},{"id":"p10s6","text":"**: DSH calls `oc-cua.mjs` → `ssh` into the Windows host →
invokes `cua-driver call <tool> '<json>'`"},{"id":"p10s7","text":" → the driver operates the real desktop (snapshot,
click/type/hotkey, browser via CDP, app launch) *"},{"id":"p10s8","text":"*through the host desktop session**."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## 2. - Echo, notif"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"ication acknowledgement, trusted commands, bridge-confined file access and status; SSH + Cua Driver "},{"id":"p12s5","text":"for desktop operations.
- Node >=22.13. Stop all old consumers before first initialization or upgrad"},{"id":"p12s6","text":"e and follow lease migration.
- Shared browsers/desktops require one resource executor or external r"},{"id":"p12s7","text":"esource coordination; task leases govern task ownership and result commits."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## 3.
